claims.text: From artifact `621a26ec7b4419d76351b43e22fff9df644945c6458e2a531d2542a0819b6602`, \(Q_d\) is torsion-free of ranks \(1,1,2,1,1\) in degrees \(6,7,8,9,10\), respectively. [artifact 621a26ec7b4419d76351b43e22fff9df644945c6458e2a531d2542a0819b6602]

Thus the degreewise transition matrices \(T_d\), defined by \([G_R]_Q=[G_L]_Q\,T_d\), are \[ T_6=(1),\quad T_7=(-1),\quad T_8=\begin{pmatrix}0&1\\1&0\end{pmatrix},\quad T_9=(-1),\quad T_{10}=(1), \] each unimodular. [artifact 621a26ec7b4419d76351b43e22fff9df644945c6458e2a531d2542a0819b6602]
